chunks: The Christ will never disdain to be a servant of God, nor will the angels close to Him. And those who disdain to serve Him and are proud, He will gather them all to Him.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Jesus and the angels regarding their servitude to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the humanity and servitude of Jesus (Isa) and the high status of the Muqarrabun angels, countering claims of their divinity or independence. It underscores the universal accountability of all beings, from the most humble prophets to the most proud, before the Day of Judgment.
